sources.title: Register or manage a high-rise residential building
sources.role: Building Safety Regulator service guidance for registration and structure/fire-safety information.
sources.facts: Published 4 April 2024. Service availability and required submissions do not prove a named building is registered or compliant.
sources.guard: Building Safety Regulator registration, application, certificate, safety-case, occurrence-reporting and building-control guidance does not by itself prove that a particular building is registered, compliant, safe, certified, approved, free of defects or permitted for occupation.

sources.title: Apply for a building assessment certificate
sources.role: Official service guidance for BAC applications after regulator direction.
sources.facts: Updated 10 April 2026. An application requirement or submission is not evidence that a certificate has been issued.
sources.guard: Building Safety Regulator registration, application, certificate, safety-case, occurrence-reporting and building-control guidance does not by itself prove that a particular building is registered, compliant, safe, certified, approved, free of defects or permitted for occupation.

sources.title: Preparing a building assessment certificate application
sources.role: Official requirements for information submitted in a BAC application.
sources.facts: Updated 1 April 2026. The regulator assesses whether legal duties are being met; preparation guidance does not establish the decision.
sources.guard: Building Safety Regulator registration, application, certificate, safety-case, occurrence-reporting and building-control guidance does not by itself prove that a particular building is registered, compliant, safe, certified, approved, free of defects or permitted for occupation.

sources.title: Managing high-rise residential buildings
sources.role: Official collection covering registration, accountable-person duties, safety cases and occurrence reporting.
sources.facts: Collection contents include April 2026 BAC updates and multiple distinct duties; collection presence is not a building-level status record.
sources.guard: Building Safety Regulator registration, application, certificate, safety-case, occurrence-reporting and building-control guidance does not by itself prove that a particular building is registered, compliant, safe, certified, approved, free of defects or permitted for occupation.

sources.title: Preparing a safety case report
sources.role: Official guidance on documenting building-safety risks and their management.
sources.facts: Updated 6 December 2024. A safety case report describes risk management but does not itself prove the regulator accepts it or that no risk remains.
sources.guard: Building Safety Regulator registration, application, certificate, safety-case, occurrence-reporting and building-control guidance does not by itself prove that a particular building is registered, compliant, safe, certified, approved, free of defects or permitted for occupation.

sources.title: Operating a mandatory occurrence reporting system
sources.role: Official guidance on mandatory occurrence reporting systems for higher-risk buildings.
sources.facts: Updated 6 December 2024. A reporting system is a legal process and does not establish that no unreported occurrence or building defect exists.
sources.guard: Building Safety Regulator registration, application, certificate, safety-case, occurrence-reporting and building-control guidance does not by itself prove that a particular building is registered, compliant, safe, certified, approved, free of defects or permitted for occupation.

sources.title: Building control approval for higher-risk buildings
sources.role: Official guidance on BSR building-control approval for higher-risk building work.
sources.facts: BSR approval assesses proposed compliance and project management; guidance or application status does not prove final construction compliance.
sources.guard: Building Safety Regulator registration, application, certificate, safety-case, occurrence-reporting and building-control guidance does not by itself prove that a particular building is registered, compliant, safe, certified, approved, free of defects or permitted for occupation.

sources.title: Applying for a completion certificate
sources.role: Official March 2025 guidance for full or partial completion-certificate applications.
sources.facts: A completion certificate follows regulator assessment and inspection; an application or completed works claim is not the certificate decision.
sources.guard: Building Safety Regulator registration, application, certificate, safety-case, occurrence-reporting and building-control guidance does not by itself prove that a particular building is registered, compliant, safe, certified, approved, free of defects or permitted for occupation.
